evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and directly alters standardness rules for Taproot annex acceptance in src/policy/policy.cpp.
rationale: Relaxes standardness rules to allow Taproot transactions with unstructured annexes into the mempool. As stated in the problem description, transactions with annexes are currently treated as non-standard, preventing relay of transactions using marker-based opt-in semantics or unstructured witness data. This provides a clear use case for users wishing to relay annex data without being category-critical or urgent.
